events.title: Band Stage Demo Available Now for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hi everyone,We’re the team behind Band Stage, and we’re thrilled to announce that our demo is now live for Steam Next Fest!We built this game because we love the feeling of playing music—the moment your fingers move with the melody. We wanted to capture that in a game, but with a twist.What makes it different? events.title: Fix for the story loading freeze at 100%
events.summary: Dear players,We would like to share an update on the fix for a known issue.Recently we received reports that some players, after creating a character and trying to enter the story, would see the loading progress bar get stuck at 100% and be unable to continue, which prevented them from experiencing the following content. Our technical team has located the issue and fixed it.
